description: Writes romanised (Latin-letter) text in an Indian script by sound, e.g. 'namaste' → 'नमस्ते' for Hindi or 'vaNakkam' → 'வணக்கம்' for Tamil. This is transliteration, not translation: spell the words as they sound in the target language. Keys follow ITRANS/Baraha conventions: capitals for long vowels and retroflex consonants (A I U E O, T D N L Sh), M = anusvara, H = visarga. Use get_keymap for a language's exact keys.

language.description: Target language code or name, e.g. 'hi', 'ta', 'kn', 'Bengali', 'sat' (Santali, Ol Chiki).

text.description: Romanised text to transliterate. Punctuation, digits and spaces are kept.

name: transliterate
title: Transliterate romanised text
